# DoneRelay

> Self-hosted Telegram and experimental WeChat/Weixin notifications, questions and
> one-time approvals for AI agents. Node.js developer preview, not a hosted service.

- [Overview and setup](https://github.com/tianxinzh/DoneRelay/blob/main/README.md)
- [中文说明](https://github.com/tianxinzh/DoneRelay/blob/main/README.zh-CN.md)
- [Architecture and API](https://github.com/tianxinzh/DoneRelay/blob/main/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md)
- [Security boundaries](https://github.com/tianxinzh/DoneRelay/blob/main/SECURITY.md)
- [Skill instructions](https://github.com/tianxinzh/DoneRelay/blob/main/skills/donerelay/SKILL.md)
- [Actual distribution status](https://github.com/tianxinzh/DoneRelay/blob/main/docs/MARKETPLACES.md)

Capabilities are implementation claims unless explicitly labeled live-verified.
The initial test suite is offline. No claim of official marketplace acceptance,
universal personal WeChat eligibility, existing-session takeover or cloud control.
